UI_setting_macrosList: Available macros: {icons} - vehicle icons, {names} - player names, {vehicles} - vehicle names, {icons_names} - icons with names, {icons_vehicles} - icons with vehicle names, {full} - complete information, {damage} - damage amount
UI_macros_help:
Use these macros in your message formats to customize notifications:
• {icons} - Shows vehicle icons
• {names} - Shows player names
• {vehicles} - Shows vehicle names
• {icons_names} - Shows icons with player names
• {icons_vehicles} - Shows icons with vehicle names
• {full} - Shows complete information
• {damage} - Shows damage amount (for assist messages only)
